note: Both sets share severe hallucinations, including reading the page number '19' as Rotor Thrust (19 MN), the Y-axis maximum as Rotor Speed (20 RPM), and inventing 4 MW power at cut-in. However, Set B is better because it correctly extracts Blade Pitch values (0° in Region 2, ~22° at 25 m/s) which Set A largely misses or marks unspecified. Set B also accurately describes the Generator Power plateau (15 MW in Region 3, 11-25 m/s), whereas Set A incorrectly claims 15 MW is reached at 10 m/s. Set B captures the Design Point coefficients (Cp=0.489) more consistently than Set A.
